name: Sumeragi Ayano
source:
Ayano is [url=/c82594]Satoru's[/url] childhood friend. They have been very close to each other for years but they see each other much less in the last five years because they have not been in the same class since. Having become an otaku/gamer/NEET at a time when she was no longer seeing much of Satoru, her passion for this world worsened when she began to live by herself. Since the beginning of the new school year, Ayano has been sharing her class with Satoru again but she doesn't know it yet because her passion for an online game has made her forget the notion of time and she has been missing classes since the beginning of the school year. 

It is therefore with surprise and joy that she learns from her childhood friend that they are together again, but her joy is short-lived because her long absence from school has attracted the anger of her mother who gives her an ultimatum if she wants to continue living alone...

[spoiler]Ayano hides the fact that she is an otaku/gamer/NEET from everyone, only Satoru knows her like that. So in the eyes of others, Ayano is like a pretty princess.

Ayano is actually an ultra popular girl and has already been confessed many times by an incredible number of boys.[/spoiler]
